isometricprojection.configuration.title: Isometric Projection Settings
config.isometricprojection.showGuide: Show guide when joining a world
config.isometricprojection.cutawayEnable: Sets the local cutaway preference. Illusion connections temporarily turn it off.
config.isometricprojection.cutawayRadius: Sets the radius of the opening around your head in the isometric view.
Sets how far the opening extends from your head toward the camera.
config.isometricprojection.undergroundRa: Sets how wide an area above your head is hidden while underground or otherwise without sky access.
config.isometricprojection.defaultSpan.t: Sets the visible vertical span. Applies when the settings are loaded or saved.
config.isometricprojection.zoomStep.tool: Sets how many blocks the visible height changes with each zoom key press.
config.isometricprojection.rotationMilli: Sets how long a 90-degree camera turn takes.
config.isometricprojection.zoomMillis.to: Sets how long each zoom transition takes.
config.isometricprojection.showHud.toolt: Shows the status of isometric view, illusion connections, and cutaway above the hotbar.
config.isometricprojection.showGuide.too: Shows a short guide in chat each time you join a world.
message.isometricprojection.server_suppo: [Isometric Projection] Compatible server detected. Use %s to toggle illusion connections.
message.isometricprojection.client_only: [Isometric Projection] Client features only. Illusion connections (%s) are unavailable on this server.
